blocks.text: جمل أطول ومفردات أقلّ شيوعًا. الكلمات الجديدة في معظمها مشروحة أدناه.
If you need some help with that, let me know.
blocks.note: إن احتجت للمساعدة في ذلك، أخبرني.

blocks.text: Why didn't you let me know you were in New York?
blocks.note: لِم لَم تخبرني أنك كنت في نيويورك؟

blocks.text: Do you really think that I'm going to let you do that?
Do what has to be done.
Do as you would be done by.
blocks.note: عامل الناس كما تحب أن يعاملوك

blocks.text: Tom has done so much for me.
blocks.note: لقد فعل توم الكثير من أجلي.

blocks.text: Do you know what he has done?
Who could have done something like this?
I don't know if he would have done it for me.
blocks.note: لا أدري إن كان ليفعلها لأجلي.

sentences.t: I'm from Australia.
I come from Australia.
I'm in Australia right now.
Have you been to Australia?
You should come to Australia.
When did Tom come to Australia?
Do I really have to go to Australia with Tom?
sentences.ar: هل يتوجب علي حقاً الذهاب إلى أستراليا مع توم؟

sentences.t: I told you before!
I've been here before.
Were you there before?
sentences.ar: هل سبق وكنت هناك من قبل ؟

sentences.t: Has he done this before?
We have never done it before.
sentences.ar: لم يسبق لنا و أن قمنا بهذا من قبل.

sentences.t: Ken has been to England before.
Why didn't you just say that before?
I've told you before that I don't like that.
sentences.ar: لقد أخبرتك مسبقا أننى لا أحب هذا

sentences.t: We have a lot of work to do before we can go home.
sentences.ar: لدينا الكثير من العمل للقيام به قبل الذهاب للمنزل

sentences.t: Go to school.
I go to school.
